about:
We are happy to tell you guys about` KamavoSian`s new album [I was cold beside you] with some amazing remixes by` Lucinee, Matrheim and Tøtal.
atwork by` Erskine Designs

Lucinee is a Hamburg based Techno DJ and Producer. She made her first appearances in the beginning of 2015 and quickly drew attention due to her powerful, energetic and uncompromising Style.
Lucinee also started to focus on her own productions using only her analogue and digital hardware synthesizer setup to record tracks and has recently released her debut EP “Black Moon” (12”) on Snork Enterprises and contributed a track for the Hamburg based Vinyl label “Ohne kommerziellen Wert.

Matrheim is an artist who built himself around music in his early ages thanks to his father.
Pushed forward by the notion of music sharing, he creates his own label, Eradys Records, with his best friend, Monsieur Nobody.
He is currently working with Abbey Road Studio on Paris to improve his production technique.
Supported by Dax J, Rebekah or I Hate Models, he likes to play with a mix brutal techno and rythmed, his melodic universe has no limit, all this strongly maintained with an acid wave.

Tøtal representing the header and darker side of techno In 2017 he founded his own label "Death Bell Records" where he released 8 EP and 1 LP also he used to work with another labels.
